assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness that are concerning for an underlying arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
A cardiac event monitor is ordered to capture rhythm data during symptomatic episodes to evaluate for potential atrial fibrillation or other conduction abnormalities contributing to these symptoms.
The service addresses diagnosis code I34.0.
The service addresses diagnosis code R42.
The service is associated with CPT code 93271.
